name: Justin C. Strane
tagline: Top rated Real Estate attorney in Chicago, Illinois
about: Justin Strane is the founder of Front Door Legal LLC, a Chicago firm focused on residential real estate transactions and estate planning. He represents buyers, sellers, and families navigating the decisions that matter most - closing on a home, protecting assets, planning for what comes next.

His real estate work covers the full transaction: purchase and sale contracts, title review, closings, and lease negotiations for both residential and commercial properties. On the estate planning side, he helps individuals and families build plans that hold up when it counts.

He holds a J.D. from The John Marshall Law School (now UIC School of Law), where he was an editor of the Review of Intellectual Property Law and took first place in a national moot court competition. He later earned an LL.M. in real estate from the same institution. He completed his undergraduate degree at the University of Michigan in 2007. Justin is admitted to practice in Illinois and before the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois.
